scientific_integrity: All numerical and group-theoretic assertions are supported by a self-contained deterministic standard-library-only verifier. No independent validation or theorem for all cube dimensions is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete integral homology and integral symmetry lattice for the fixed five-cube; does not determine unstable homotopy attaching maps or assert a sphere-wedge decomposition. Original rational ranks were computed previously using Alexander duality; the novel parts are torsion-freeness, the integral explicit basis and group action. Equivalent unindexed sources cannot be excluded.
title: Integral homology and the full cube-symmetry lattice of the five-cube independence complex
